excerpts.author: serenita_io
excerpts.content:
Looks like most clients have implemented the POST `produceBlockV4` at this point.

I'd appreciate it if people could take a look at the `produceBlockV4WithBid` PR next: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627 . It's probably the last non-trivial Beacon API change for Hoodi.

There are already draft PRs implementing the new endpoint in 2 clients at this point:
https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/10072
https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/10099
